SELECT t.topic_code,     t.topic_name,     t.topic_group_code,     t.locale_code AS topic_locale_code,     t.summary_text AS topic_summary_text,     t.lightness_level,     m.material_id,     m.material_kind_code,     m.locale_code AS material_locale_code,     m.season_code,     m.title_text,     m.body_text,     m.tags,     m.enabled,     m.sort_order,     m.created_at,     m.updated_at,     lower(concat_ws(' '::text, t.topic_code, t.topic_name, t.topic_group_code, m.material_kind_code, COALESCE(m.season_code, ''::text), m.title_text, m.body_text, array_to_string(m.tags, ' '::text))) AS material_search_text    FROM (cx22073jw.topic_material m      JOIN cx22073jw.topic_reference t ON ((t.topic_code = m.topic_code)))   WHERE ((t.enabled = true) AND (m.enabled = true));

SELECT t.topic_code,     t.topic_name,     t.topic_group_code,     t.lightness_level,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE (m.enabled = true)) AS enabled_material_count,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE ((m.enabled = true) AND (m.season_code IS NOT NULL))) AS seasonal_material_count,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE ((m.enabled = true) AND (m.material_kind_code = 'fact'::text))) AS fact_count,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE ((m.enabled = true) AND (m.material_kind_code = 'prompt'::text))) AS prompt_count,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE ((m.enabled = true) AND (m.material_kind_code = 'observation'::text))) AS observation_count,     count(m.material_id) FILTER (WHERE ((m.enabled = true) AND (m.material_kind_code = 'example'::text))) AS example_count    FROM (cx22073jw.topic_reference t      LEFT JOIN cx22073jw.topic_material m ON ((m.topic_code = t.topic_code)))   WHERE (t.enabled = true)   GROUP BY t.topic_code, t.topic_name, t.topic_group_code, t.lightness_level;
